open_questions: tools/project_workflow.html shows as modified in git; I did not edit it (probably regenerated by a hook or tool). Keep or revert as you prefer.
By design no link exists between two asteroid fields, and a Space Storage is never a route source. The test asserts the first; say if you want either to change.
handoff: Added _test_links_everywhere (run_tests.gd, called after the cluster-to-station test). Two passes, each with discovery set explicitly: start state plus unlocks bought the player way (FND_PERMIT, buy_permit(2), FND_STORAGE, FND_PROSPECT, the dead-world mining skills with their prerequisite chains, cycle 15), and discovery on with every post/platform built through a Pathfinder flight. Nodes: all planets, both dead worlds, both Space Storages, all asteroid clusters (systems 1 and 2). For each pair, in each direction a route can run, it uses Main.send_stock_buying (buys the ship), checks the route exists, is in collect_state, and survives JSON plus apply_state. Storage pairs use StorageLink.build_link with the same save and load check. Also asserts every type pair was covered in the same system and across systems, and that every node is reachable from the home world by working links (none stranded). Result: sh tools/tests/run.sh gives pass=2810 fail=0. No game bugs found, so no game code changed; balance.json untouched.

notes: Same-system storage pair does not exist (one Space Storage per system); asserted as cross-system only.
Storage link needs both storages stocked with rivets and energy; the test stocks them.
Dead worlds: dead_1 needs MIN_3 (via MIN_1), dead_2 needs MIN_5 (via MIN_3); platforms need MIN_3.
